args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history**: Found that v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy.

2. **Rolled back all regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the health check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback action taken.

4. **Verified service status**: checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 across all regions and is reporting healthy, with a low error rate of 0.2%.

2. **Rolled back all regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**.
